title: ledger.entries.v1
description: One of the two messages on the Redpanda topic ledger.entries.v1 that services/amqp-redpanda-bridge produces for one TigerBeetle CDC change event — the debit leg and the credit leg — each keyed by accountId so every event touching an account lands in one partition, in commit order. Every field is derived, unchanged, from the `tigerbeetle amqp` 0.17.4 change-event payload. See contracts/events/README.md for provenance and the versioning rule. The consumer-side decoder is dev.fondaria.ledger.event.LedgerEventDecoder in libs/ledger-client.

schemaVersion.description: The event schema version. A consumer that does not recognise this value must route the message to its dead-letter topic, never attempt a best-effort parse. A backwards-incompatible change is a new version (v2) on a new topic, not an edit here.

eventType.description: The TigerBeetle change-event type, lower snake_case.

ledger.description: The TigerBeetle ledger id (u32). 484 is the single MXN cash ledger; a value >= 1001 is a per-fund unit ledger. The decoder routes on this: 484 -> Money, >= 1001 -> Units; any other value is a hard decode error. Every quantity on this event (amount and the four balance counters) is denominated the same way.

timestamp.description: The change event's ledger commit timestamp, u64 nanoseconds since the Unix epoch.

transferId.description: The transfer id (u128) that produced this entry. Not the partition key for this topic.

transferCode.description: The transfer's user-defined code (u16); maps to LedgerCodes.TransferCode.

transferTimestamp.description: The transfer's own commit timestamp, u64 nanoseconds since the Unix epoch.

amount.description: The transfer amount (u128). MXN cents on the cash ledger; units scaled by 1e8 on a unit ledger. A fractional value in any form is rejected by the decoder, never coerced.

direction.description: Which leg of the transfer this entry is. The debit leg carries the debited account; the credit leg the credited account.

accountId.description: This entry's account id (u128). The Redpanda partition key for this topic.

accountCode.description: This account's code (u16); maps to LedgerCodes.AccountCode.

debitsPending.description: This account's debits_pending counter after the event (u128), same denomination as amount.

debitsPosted.description: This account's debits_posted counter after the event (u128), same denomination as amount.

creditsPending.description: This account's credits_pending counter after the event (u128), same denomination as amount.

creditsPosted.description: This account's credits_posted counter after the event (u128), same denomination as amount.

pendingId.description: The originating pending transfer id on a two-phase post/void; "0" otherwise.

uint128.description: An unsigned integer of up to 128 bits, carried as a canonical base-10 string (no leading zeros, no sign, no decimal point).
